name: The Blighted Cloister
source: Black Death City Playtest v1.03, pp.113-131 (printed page numbers)

strongholds.name: Fortified Keep
strongholds.text: Martial Training: aftermath step 3, up to 3 Knights earn d6 bonus XP. Search the City: if you won, 1 additional re-roll when searching the City.

strongholds.name: Secluded Scriptorium
strongholds.text: Blasphemous Study: each aftermath pick one: Scry Ancient Scrolls (roll a dice per Wizard into a tally; each multiple of 20 lets a Wizard reach its next advancement), or Brew Concoctions (a dice per Wizard; each 5+ adds a Vial of Poison to the stash).

strongholds.name: Unholy Altar
strongholds.text: Demonic Communion: before the aftermath roll 3d6 if you won, 2d6 if you lost.

table.2: Damnation: your leader is killed; add a Demonic Rotspawn for free bearing their name.
table.13-15: Demonic Ally: add a Rot Demon or a Rotling for free.

strongholds.name: Street Pulpit
strongholds.text: Venerate Living Saints: each time a Dreg Cultist earns a level of Black Rot, +5 XP. Canonise the Fallen: each time a fighter is killed, every Dreg Cultist earns 10 bonus XP in aftermath step 3.

special_rules.name: Master of Dark Spellcraft
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Blessed Maggots. Pick 2 signature spells; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Dark Spellcraft
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Blessed Maggots. Pick 1 signature spell; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Darkcloven Magic
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Blessed Maggots and the Demonic Lore of Rot, with no signature spells; prepares 1 random spell from each lore every battle.

special_rules.name: Ram Horns
special_rules.text: After finishing a Charge Move, pick 1 enemy engaged with it; that enemy is hit by 2 attacks (Rend -1, Damage 1).

special_rules.name: Demonic Spellcraft
special_rules.text: Knows the Demonic Lore of Rot. Pick 1 signature spell; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Demonic Wards
special_rules.text: Ignores Rend when making armour rolls.

special_rules.name: Fear
special_rules.text: Causes fear: enemies starting their activation engaged with it must pass a Willpower test or their activation immediately ends. Fear-causers ignore this.

armour.name: Warded Robes
armour.text: Each time targeted by an enemy spell, roll a dice; on a 4+ the spell has no effect on this fighter.

armour.name: Full-Plate
armour.text: Cannot be equipped with two-handed ranged weapons, except a Brace of Pistols.

items.name: Cauldron
items.text: [Action] Take a Willpower test; if passed, pick a spell from a lore this fighter knows to be prepared.

items.name: Cloister Icon
items.text: While on the battlefield you can re-roll flee tests. Re-roll Willpower tests for friendly fighters within 12" that can see this fighter.

items.name: Demonic Familiar
items.text: Each melee attack, make 1 additional attack with this weapon.
items.note: Armoury list says 30s, item card says 20s (p.118 vs p.120).

items.name: Ensorcelled Bell
items.text: Once per battle, re-roll a miscast roll made for this fighter.

items.name: Grimoire
items.text: Once per battle, after this fighter has made a casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

spells.name: Swollen Form
spells.text: A visible friendly fighter within 9" ignores the first 3 points of damage it suffers until end of round.

spells.name: Black Mire
spells.text: Pick a visible point on the battlefield floor within 6"; until end of round, floor within 6" of it is a mire: non-Cloister fighters subtract 2 from their maximum move each time they move across it.

spells.name: Erupting Sores
spells.text: The closest visible enemy within 9" suffers d3 damage; if not taken down it must pass a Willpower test or scatter d6".

spells.name: Rain of Filth
spells.text: Blast template on a point within 12", scatters d6"; each fighter in it heals d3.

spells.name: Putrid Blessing
spells.text: A friendly fighter within 6": its melee weapons gain Arcane and Poison until end of round.

spells.name: Black Bile
spells.text: Place the flame template from the caster; each fighter in it is hit.
spells.crit_text: Each fighter hit must pass a Willpower test or become poisoned.

spells.name: Summon Rotling
spells.text: A summoned Rotling joins until taken down, set up within 3" of the caster, not engaged. Max 3 summoned fighters.

spells.name: Demonic Strength
spells.text: A friendly Demon or Beastman within 6": +1 Damage and Critical Damage for melee weapons until end of round.

spells.name: Rotten Insides
spells.text: The closest visible enemy within 9" suffers 1 damage; if not taken down its Move is 2" until it passes a Willpower test at the end of one of its activations.

spells.name: Plague Wind
spells.text: Blast template on a point within 15"; each enemy in it must pass a Willpower test or become poisoned.

spells.name: Protective Shroud
spells.text: A friendly Demon or Beastman within 6" improves Armour by 1 until end of round.

spells.name: Plague Pit
spells.text: Blast template on a visible floor point within 9": a pit opens until end of round. Fighters in it are set up at its edge, not engaged, then must pass an Initiative test or suffer d3 damage and be poisoned. Floor fighters cannot move across the pit; treasure on it is destroyed.

skills.name: Shepherd the Afflicted
skills.text: +1" maximum move for other friendly fighters that start a move within 6".

skills.name: Demonic Conduit
skills.text: Once per battle, a friendly Demon arriving from reserve may be set up within 3" of this fighter, not engaged.

skills.name: Rite of Contagion
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action while not engaged: each enemy within 12" must pass a Willpower test or suffer 1 damage and be poisoned.

skills.name: Last Rites
skills.text: Each time another fighter is taken down within 6", heal 1.

skills.name: Unholy Sermon
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action while not engaged: until end of round, +1 to melee attack rolls for friendly fighters within 6".

skills.name: The Black Benediction
skills.text: -1 Damage and Critical Damage (min 1) for weapons targeting this fighter.

skills.name: Infested with Maggots
skills.text: Each activation, if damaged, roll a dice; on a 4+ heal 1.

skills.name: Toxic Miasma
skills.text: Enemies activating while engaged with it must pass a Willpower test or suffer 1 damage.

skills.name: Shroud of Flies
skills.text: -1 to attack rolls that target this fighter.

skills.name: Vessel of Black Rot
skills.text: When taken down, roll a dice for each enemy within 6"; on a 4+ it becomes poisoned.

skills.name: Vector of Entropy
skills.text: Worsen the Armour of enemies engaged with it by 1 (min '-').

demon_injury_table_d66.11-16: Banished: removed from roster, wargear lost.
demon_injury_table_d66.21-36: Fractured Essence: misses the next battle.
demon_injury_table_d66.66: Enraged: no lasting effects; gains bonus XP to reach the next level.
